title: Sentinel Task Contract
description: S3 typed, machine-readable Task Contract (ML-DEVOS-RFC-013 / ML-DEVOS-AS-038 / D-042). A Task Contract is a compact, typed description of scope, acceptance criteria, and claim/evidence expectations for a single already-authorized task. It never itself grants authority, tool access, credentials, remote-resource access, merge approval, deployment approval, or risk acceptance (CORE-001, CORE-002) -- see the required `authority_disclaimer` field, whose value this schema fixes verbatim so no instance can weaken it. This schema is descriptive/structural only; see TASK_CONTRACT_SPEC.md for the semantic rules (CORE-016/017/018/020) that validate-task-contract.mjs enforces beyond what a JSON Schema can express.

contract_schema_version.description: Version of this schema the instance was authored against, not the Sentinel governance-capability version.

task_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this task. Uniqueness across contracts is a repository-level convention this schema cannot itself enforce for a single instance file.

project.description: Repository/project this task is scoped to, e.g. 'Dillaab-source/maisog-labs'.

change_class.description: Reuses the existing change-class vocabulary from devos/governance/change-policy/CHANGE_GOVERNANCE_POLICY.md and devos/governance/registry/rule-record.schema.json rather than inventing a parallel taxonomy.

authorization_references.description: IDs (RFC/Architect Sync/Decision/ADR) that already authorized this task's scope. Required and non-empty: a Task Contract with no authorization reference would itself look like a claim of self-granted authority, which CORE-001/CORE-002 forbid.

allowed_paths.description: Bounded repository paths or artifact domains this task may modify. Describes already-authorized scope; does not itself grant write access.

scope.description: The five boolean flags let validate-task-contract.mjs determine whether CORE-020's consequence-sensitive evidence escalation applies, without re-deriving that judgment from prose.

statement.description: Describes an expected outcome. Its presence here never certifies that the outcome occurred -- that is a claim/evidence matter, not an acceptance-criterion matter.

claim_kind.description: V1 bounded claim-kind vocabulary (ML-DEVOS-RFC-013). Additional kinds require a future governed extension, not an ad hoc addition to this schema.

all_of.description: Every listed evidence class is independently required (AND semantics), reusing the exact all_of/any_of shape from rule-record.schema.json rather than inventing a second evidence-combination grammar.

any_of.description: At least one listed evidence class is required (OR semantics) whenever this array is non-empty.

authority_disclaimer.const: This Task Contract describes already-authorized scope. It does not itself grant authority, tool access, credentials, remote-resource access, merge approval, deployment approval, or risk acceptance (CORE-001, CORE-002). Satisfying this contract's acceptance criteria and evidence requirements does not certify task success or accept the task; that judgment belongs to the Architect/Paulo review that consumes this contract's evidence, not to the contract or its validator.
authority_disclaimer.description: Fixed verbatim by `const` so no instance can soften, omit, or reword the non-authority boundary (ML-DEVOS-AS-038 AS38-F002).
